newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Southcoast cuts Data Race.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Southcoast cuts Data Race.

text.p: Southcoast Capital analyst James McIlree said he cut his short-term rating on Data Race Inc, a modem maker, to neutral from buy, but kept his long-term buy rating.
-- The analyst said that delays in winning acceptance for a new product line have led him to cut his earnings estimates for the 1997 and 1998 fiscal years.
-- For fiscal 1998, McIlree said he slashed his earnings estimate to $0.68 from $1.52 per share. He said he expected a wider loss during the 1997 year, but did not offer specifics.

-- In February, Data Race introduced to postive critical reviews a product called Be There! that allows travellers, for example, to route phone, fax and internet communications directly from home offices to remote locations such as hotels.
